steps.title: One number places five cards
steps.titleZh: 一个数字排好五张卡片
steps.text: `slots(count, current)` in `geometry.js` works out every card's place from `current`, the index of the front card. It takes each card's distance from the front card, wrapped to between −2 and 2, then sets `x = distance * 90`, `scale = 0.78 ** |distance|`, opacity `1 / (|distance| + 1)`, and the highest `z-index` for the front card, so nearer cards cover the ones behind. The readouts list what `app.js` wrote on cards 1 to 5.
steps.textZh: `geometry.js` 里的 `slots(count, current)` 只凭 `current`（最前面那张卡片的序号）算出每张卡片的位置。它先求出每张卡片与最前面那张的距离，并绕回到 −2 到 2 之间，然后设定 `x = distance * 90`、`scale = 0.78 ** |distance|`、不透明度 `1 / (|distance| + 1)`；最前面的卡片 `z-index` 最大，所以近处的卡片会盖住后面的。读数列出 `app.js` 写在卡片 1 到 5 上的值。

steps.title: Next card: everything is recomputed
steps.text: Click **Next layered card**: `current` becomes 1, and `render` recomputes all five cards from that one number. Card 2 moves to the front and gets `aria-current="true"`, which tells assistive technology such as screen readers which card is current. A CSS transition animates the change.
steps.textZh: 点击**下一张层叠卡片**：`current` 变成 1，`render` 根据这一个数字重新计算全部五张卡片。卡片 2 移到最前面，并得到 `aria-current="true"`，告诉屏幕阅读器等辅助技术当前是哪一张。CSS 过渡负责动画。

steps.title: Fast clicks keep the order
steps.text: This button clicks **Next layered card** four times in a row, much faster than the 0.3-second animation. Each click only changes `current` and recomputes; nothing is read back from the page, so no lock is needed while an animation runs. After Card 5 comes Card 1 again: the carousel wraps around.
steps.textZh: 这个按钮连点四次**下一张层叠卡片**，比 0.3 秒的动画快得多。每次点击只改变 `current` 并重新计算，从不从页面上读回位置，所以动画进行中也不需要加锁。卡片 5 之后又回到卡片 1：轮播会循环。

action.run: const next = document.querySelector("#layers [data-step='1']"); for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) next.click();

steps.actionLabel: Click Next layered card four times
steps.actionLabelZh: 连点四次「下一张层叠卡片」

steps.title: Scroll Snap: the browser scrolls
steps.text: The second carousel is a strip that the browser scrolls. `scroll-snap-type: x mandatory` on the strip and `scroll-snap-align: start` on each card make every scroll come to rest on a whole card. Click **Next snap card**: it calls `scrollTo` with smooth scrolling, and a `scroll` listener works out the card from `scrollLeft` and updates the text.
steps.textZh: 第二个轮播是一条由浏览器负责滚动的长条。长条上的 `scroll-snap-type: x mandatory` 加上每张卡片的 `scroll-snap-align: start`，让每次滚动都停在一整张卡片上。点击**下一张吸附卡片**：它调用 `scrollTo` 平滑滚动，`scroll` 监听器根据 `scrollLeft` 算出当前是哪一张，并更新文字。

steps.title: Any scroll counts
steps.text: The text follows every scroll, not only the buttons: a swipe, the mouse wheel or a script. This button sets `scrollLeft` to the end of the strip from a script, without smooth scrolling. The `scroll` listener computes `Math.round(scrollLeft / clientWidth)`, shows `Card 5` and disables **Next snap card**.
steps.textZh: 文字跟随每一次滚动，而不只是按钮：手指滑动、鼠标滚轮或者脚本都一样。这个按钮用脚本把 `scrollLeft` 直接设到长条的末端，不做平滑滚动。`scroll` 监听器计算 `Math.round(scrollLeft / clientWidth)`，显示「卡片 5」，并禁用**下一张吸附卡片**。
steps.actionLabel: Scroll the strip to the end

watch.label: card at this scrollLeft
watch.labelZh: 按 scrollLeft 算出的卡片

steps.title: Try both by hand
steps.text: Swipe the strip or scroll it sideways: it always comes to rest on a whole card, and it stops at the ends. Focus the layered carousel with the Tab key and press the arrow keys; it does not respond to swipes. When your system's reduce-motion setting is on, the snap buttons jump instead of scrolling smoothly, and `style.css`, the stylesheet all visual demos share, makes the layered cards move almost at once.
steps.textZh: 用手指滑动长条，或者横向滚动它：它总会停在一整张卡片上，滚到两端就停下。用 Tab 键让层叠轮播获得焦点，再按方向键；它不响应滑动手势。如果系统开启了“减少动态效果”，Scroll Snap 的按钮会直接跳到目标卡片，不再平滑滚动；所有视觉示例共用的样式表 `style.css` 也会让层叠卡片几乎瞬间就位。
